summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting to signed-in account  I did not change any files. Below is what I found by reading the code, and what I'd propose doing next.  ### What I checked and found to be correctly wired - **Server-side scoping is sound.** `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` requires a valid session on every route, resolves `X-User-Id` from the session, and every query (list, get, create item, delete item) filters by `watchlists.user_id = userId`. No cross-user leakage or anonymous fallback in this file. - **Client has no anonymous/local storage fallback.** `Watchlist
